label: dormwar4
title_zh: 活力全开！全力运动竞技！

lines.en: label dormwar4:
scene sky
It’s surprisingly tolerable outside today- which is great because the next part of the dorm war is apparently going to take place at the park.
lines.zh: 今天外面意外地还算舒服——这很好，因为宿舍大战的下一部分显然要在公园进行。

lines.en: It’s also apparently going to be a battle between Kirin and Miku, so I’m pretty sure I already know how it’s going to end.
lines.zh: 而且显然会是 Kirin 和 Miku 之间的对决，所以我很确定自己已经知道结局会怎样了。

lines.en: Not to throw shade at Kirin or anything, of course. I mean, she’s about as athletic as someone who was born with a nice body and a poor work ethic can be.
lines.zh: 当然，我不是要贬低 Kirin。我的意思是，她的运动能力，大概就是一个天生身材好却毫无干劲的人所能达到的上限。

lines.en: But in order to take down Miku, she’ll need to either take performance enhancing drugs or rely on some sort of underhanded tactics to-
lines.zh: 但想要击败 Miku，她要么得吃兴奋剂，要么得靠某种卑鄙的手段——

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: You know, maybe Kirin might win after all?
lines.zh: 你知道吗，搞不好 Kirin 还真会赢？

lines.en: Her roommate had no problem drugging me to gain an advantage in her competition. So maybe Kirin will drug Miku or something and win that way.
lines.zh: 她的室友为了在比赛里占上风，给我下药时眼睛都不眨一下。所以也许 Kirin 会给 Miku 下药什么的，然后那样取胜。

lines.en: Thing is, if that actually happens, I’ll have to get as far away as possible as quickly as possible.
lines.zh: 问题是，如果真发生这种事，我必须尽快跑得越远越好。

lines.en: I’ve been able to fend off any suspicion from the general public as far as being seen with all of the girls goes, but I feel like it wouldn’t be that easy if one of them was unconscious in broad daylight.
lines.zh: 一直以来，我和这些女生在一起被人看到还能躲过公众的怀疑，但要是其中一个光天化日之下昏倒在地，我可不觉得还能那么容易蒙混过关。

lines.en: Either way, there’s no turning back now.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，现在也没有回头路了。

lines.en: Noriko, Ami and I make our way to the park, only for the two of them to abandon me shortly after and take a walk around the neighborhood themselves.
lines.zh: Noriko、Ami 和我一起去了公园，结果她俩没多久就把我丢下，自己绕着街区散步去了。

lines.en: Sensing that the likelihood of either one of them murdering the other isn’t as high as you might expect it to be, I see no point in refusing and instead make my way over to the next two contestants.
lines.zh: 我判断她们其中一个杀掉另一个的概率并没有想象中那么高，于是觉得也没必要拒绝，便走向下两位参赛选手。

lines.en: scene athleticstest1
: Uhh...so I know it’s nicer than normal out right now, but are you really sure wearing shorts is okay?
lines.zh: : 呃……我知道现在外面比平时暖和，但你真的确定穿短裤没问题吗？

lines.en: : Course I am!
lines.zh: : 当然没问题！

lines.en: : Aren’t you like...cold, though?...
lines.zh: : 可你不会……冷吗？……

lines.en: : Maybe a little, but I’ll warm right up the second we kick things off!
lines.zh: : 可能有一点，不过等我们一开赛我就暖和起来了！

lines.en: : You wanted me to take this seriously, so I’m takin’ it seriously.
lines.zh: : 你让我认真对待，那我就认真对待。

lines.en: : Figured you would too, but here you are in a friggin’ skirt. How ya plannin’ on takin’ me down when you ain’t even dressed for the job?
lines.zh: : 我还以为你也会呢，结果你穿着条破裙子。你连衣服都没穿对，打算怎么击败我啊？

lines.en: : Good morning, you two.
lines.zh: : 早上好，你们俩。

lines.en: scene athleticstest2
: Mornin’, Sensei! Ready to watch Kirin get spanked?!
lines.zh: : 早上好，Sensei！准备好欣赏 Kirin 被打屁股了吗？！

lines.en: : Yes. And this competition just got a lot more interesting.
lines.zh: : 准备好了。而且这场比赛一下子有意思多了。

lines.en: : I feel kind of dumb for not suggesting that, actually. I’d probably have a pretty good chance of winning a test of spank endurance or whatever.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我居然没想到提这个，感觉自己有点蠢。要是比打屁股耐力什么的，我大概还真挺有希望赢的。

lines.en: : Don’t tell me you’ve already given up on victory for your {i}actual{/i} contest?
lines.zh: : 别告诉我你已经放弃在{i}正式{/i}比赛里取胜了？

lines.en: scene athleticstest3
: Nah. I mean, I know it’ll be tough. But I’m not going to just let Miku win as long as {i}you’re{/i} on the line.
lines.zh: : 没有。我是说，我知道会很难。但只要赌注是{i}你{/i}，我就不会让 Miku 轻松赢下。

lines.en: : And I’m not gonna let Kirin win cause I’m kinda scared about what that Noriko chick would do to ya if you guys slept in the same room!
lines.zh: : 我也不会让 Kirin 赢，因为我有点怕要是你们睡在同一间房，那个 Noriko 会对你做出什么来！

lines.en: : After this morning, I am also mildly afraid of that.
lines.zh: : 经过今天早上，我也多少有点怕了。

lines.en: : Looks like you recovered pretty quickly, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少看起来你恢复得挺快的。

lines.en: : Oh, good. So you knew what she was planning on doing.
lines.zh: : 哦，很好。所以你早就知道她打算干什么。

lines.en: : In her defense, no one ever told her she couldn’t do that.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，从来没人告诉过她不能那么做。

lines.en: : Well, as long as you’re not planning on drugging Miku, I’m sure this contest will be a lot more...normal.
lines.zh: : 嗯，只要你没打算给 Miku 下药，我相信这场比赛会……正常得多。

lines.en: scene athleticstest4
: Wait a sec! I feel like I’m missin’ an important detail here! What the heck happened this morning?
lines.zh: : 等一下！我好像漏掉了一个重要的细节！今天早上到底发生了什么？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 别在意了。

lines.en: : When are you two starting your thing? And how do I judge it?
lines.zh: : 你们俩什么时候开始？我要怎么评判？

lines.en: scene athleticstest5
: Oh, you don’t have to judge this one. We called in a special guest judge cause we both know you’re not good with all that athletic stuff.
lines.zh: : 哦，这场不用你评判。我们请了一位特邀评委，因为我们都知道你不擅长那些运动方面的东西。

lines.en: : I’ll have you know that I have at least one[school] year’s worth of soccer coaching experience.
lines.zh: : 我可得告诉你，我至少有整整一[school]年的足球教练经验。

lines.en: : I’m fine with you judging instead of the guest one, to be totally honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我宁可让你来评判，也不要那个特邀的。

lines.en: : Thank you for having faith in me, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你对我的信任，Kirin。

lines.en: : Oh, I don’t have any faith in you at all. I just don’t want my sister here.
lines.zh: : 哦，我对你一点信任都没有。我只是不想要我姐姐在这儿。

lines.en: : It’s a little too late for that...
lines.zh: : 现在说这个有点太晚了……

lines.en: scene athleticstest6
: Um...good...good morning!
lines.zh: : 呃……早……早上好！

lines.en: : I’m going to...help you with the contest thing...
lines.zh: : 我要来……帮忙主持这场比赛……

lines.en: : Hooraaaaay, Karin is here...
lines.zh: : 好——耶，Karin 来了……

lines.en: : Stop bein’ rude, Kirin. Yer gonna make the judge biased and have an even harder time gettin’ the W.
lines.zh: : 别这么没礼貌，Kirin。你会让评委带偏见的，到时候更难拿下胜利。

lines.en: : The only letter I want to get is the D.
lines.zh: : 我唯一想拿到的字母是 D。

lines.en: : A...draw? Why would you want to tie?
lines.zh: : 平……平局？你干嘛想打成平手？

lines.en: scene athleticstest7
: Maybe she thinks you could both get a point that way?
lines.zh: : 也许她是觉得那样你们俩都能得一分？

lines.en: : But that’s basically the same as neither of us gettin’ a point at all. I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 可那跟我们俩一分都拿不到基本没区别啊。我不懂。

lines.en: : Unless she meant getting a dog or somethin’. You guys getting a new puppy, Karin?
lines.zh: : 除非她说的是养狗什么的。你们要养新小狗了吗，Karin？

lines.en: : I hope so. Though I don’t really know why Kirin would know about it and not me.
lines.zh: : 我倒是希望如此。不过我真不知道为什么 Kirin 会知道而我却不知道。

lines.en: : How the hell do you get to be their age and not pick up on things like that?
lines.zh: : 你们俩到底怎么活到这个年纪还没搞懂这种事的？

lines.en: : Just because you’ve been corrupted by the evils of life doesn’t mean they have to be too. Leave them alone.
lines.zh: : 你被生活的邪恶腐蚀了，不代表她们也得被腐蚀。别管她们。

lines.en: scene athleticstest8
: Anyway! Why don’t ya give Sensei a breakdown of how the athletics test is gonna go, Karin?
lines.zh: : 总之！Karin，你给 Sensei 讲讲这次运动测试的流程呗？

lines.en: : Oh! R-Right!
lines.zh: : 哦！好、好的！

lines.en: : So, in order to keep things balanced, there will be three different sections of the test: Speed, strength, and endurance.
lines.zh: : 那么，为了保持平衡，测试分为三个部分：速度、力量和耐力。

lines.en: : We’ll start off with a simple sprint around the park for the speed contest.
lines.zh: : 首先是速度项目，绕公园来一场简单的短跑。

lines.en: : After that, we’ll have Miku and Kirin arm wrestle to see which one of them is the “stronger” one. Though, I have to admit that method of testing strength isn’t entirely accurate.
lines.zh: : 之后，我们会让 Miku 和 Kirin 掰手腕，看看谁更“强壮”。不过我得承认，这种测力量的方法并不完全准确。

lines.en: : Why even do it that way, then?
lines.zh: : 那为什么还要这么比？

lines.en: : The captain...uhh, Uta? She was strangely adamant about it.
lines.zh: : 是楼层长……呃，Uta？她在这点上异常坚持。

lines.en: What is with Uta and arm wrestling?
lines.zh: Uta 和掰手腕到底什么渊源？

lines.en: : And, um...the final test will just be planking. The two of them will start at the same time and whoever falls first, loses.
lines.zh: : 还有，呃……最后一项测试是平板支撑。她们俩同时开始，谁先倒下谁就输。

lines.en: : Unless, of course, one of them wins the first two contests. If that happens, there’s no reason for the third.
lines.zh: : 当然，除非有人赢下前两项。那样的话就没必要比第三项了。

lines.en: : Seems simple enough. Though, with the way it’s structured, it doesn’t really seem like there’s a reason for either of us to be involved.
lines.zh: : 听起来挺简单的。不过按这个结构，好像也没什么理由需要我和你参与。

lines.en: : Right. Each contest should have a clear winner, but it’s up to us to make sure neither of them tries cheating.
lines.zh: : 对。每项比赛都会产生明确的胜者，但我们得负责确保她们谁都不作弊。

lines.en: : No cheatin’ happenin’ here! I’m gonna win fair and square!
lines.zh: : 这儿不会有人作弊的！我要堂堂正正地赢！

lines.en: : Blah, blah, blah. At least have the dignity to beat me {i}before{/i} getting all braggy and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 吧啦吧啦吧啦。好歹{i}先{/i}赢了我再吹牛吧，有点骨气行不行。

lines.en: : Does that mean you two are ready to go then?
lines.zh: : 那意思是你们俩准备好了？

lines.en: scene athleticstest9
: Aye aye!
lines.zh: : 是，长官！

lines.en: : Ready as I’ll ever be. Let’s just get the speed part over with so we can move on to the stuff I have a chance at.
lines.zh: : 准备好了，也就这样了。赶紧把速度这一项比完，好进入我有机会的项目。

lines.en: scene black
Miku and Kirin take their places next to each other on the stone pathway and take off after Karin’s signal.
lines.zh: Miku 和 Kirin 在石板小径上并排站好，等 Karin 发令后冲了出去。

lines.en: scene athleticstest10
: C’mon, Kirin! What kinda takeoff is that?!
lines.zh: : 加油啊，Kirin！你这起跑是怎么回事？！

lines.en: : Need me to slow down and let ya catch up?!
lines.zh: : 要不要我放慢速度让你追上来？！

lines.en: : You really think mind games are going to work on me? I knew this part was over the second we started.
lines.zh: : 你真以为心理战对我有用？这一项从我们起跑的那一刻起就结束了。

lines.en: : Just hurry up and beat me so I can take you down in the arm wrestling thing.
lines.zh: : 赶紧赢了我，好让我在掰手腕那项把你干掉。

lines.en: scene athleticstest11
: You know...I’m glad you came and everything, but it doesn’t really mean anything if you don’t actually {i}cooperate{/i}.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……你能来我当然很高兴，可你要是真的不{i}配合{/i}，那也没什么意义。

lines.en: : The fuck you want me to do? Put on shorts and run around with those two fucking weirdos?
lines.zh: : 你他妈想让我干什么？穿上短裤跟那两个死变态一起跑步？

lines.en: : Something more than just stand around! All you have to do is engage with somebody and you’ll get us a point!
lines.zh: : 总比干站着强！你只要跟谁互动一下，就能给我们拿一分！

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. Let me just go out of my way and do something that will get Sensei in my room for the beach trip. Sounds like a blast.
lines.zh: : 哦对啊，让我特地去做点能让 Sensei 在海边旅行时住进我房间的事。听起来可太有意思了。

lines.en: : Are you even {i}coming{/i} to the beach this time?
lines.zh: : 你这次到底要不要{i}去{/i}海边啊？

lines.en: : Came last time, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 上次不是去了吗。

lines.en: : For a couple hours, yeah.
lines.zh: : 是啊，待了几个小时。

lines.en: : Then I’ll probably be there for a couple hours again. I ain’t fuckin’ {i}engaging{/i}, though. Just let the other girl win.
lines.zh: : 那我大概也会再待几个小时。不过我他妈才不去{i}互动{/i}呢。让另一个女生赢就是了。

lines.en: scene athleticstest12
: Yeah, I’m not really planning on “winning,” either. So you should probably just leave the two of us alone.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也没打算“赢”。所以你大概还是别管我们俩了。

lines.en: : Finally, someone who makes some fuckin’ sense.
lines.zh: : 总算来了个说人话的。

lines.en: : Sorry to interrupt, just wanted to say that.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打扰一下，我只是想说这个。

lines.en: : Isn’t you going out of your way to say that kind of what this competition is about in the first place?
lines.zh: : 你特意跑过来说这些，不本来就是这比赛的意义所在吗？

lines.en: : I hope not, because I’m already regretting my decision to come over here and say that.
lines.zh: : 我希望不是，因为我已经后悔过来跟你说这些了。

lines.en: : Anyway, bye.
lines.zh: : 总之，再见。

lines.en: scene athleticstest13
: Welp, there ya have it. We both lose.
lines.zh: : 好吧，事情就是这样。我们俩都输。

lines.en: : Ugh...why is it so hard for you to just be a little social?
lines.zh: : 呃……你就不能稍微社交一下吗，有这么难吗？

lines.en: : Why is it so hard for you to not be a bitch and just let me live my life?
lines.zh: : 你他妈就不能别这么烦人，让我过自己的日子吗？

lines.en: scene black
Miku winds up easily winning the first competition, but it’s not like Kirin really tried competing in any way.
lines.zh: Miku 轻松赢下了第一项比赛，不过 Kirin 压根就没怎么认真比。

lines.en: The two of them come back to Karin and me and sit down for a few minutes to catch their breath.
lines.zh: 她们俩回到 Karin 和我身边，坐下来喘了几分钟气。

lines.en: But as soon as they’re feeling ready to go again, they sprawl out on the ground and get into position.
lines.zh: 可一等她们缓过来，就四肢摊开趴在地上，摆好了姿势。

lines.en: Normally, that last sentence is a lot more exciting than it is in this context. But I guess there’s a time and a place for that, and a public park in the morning is not either of those things.
lines.zh: 通常情况下，上一句话的语境要比现在刺激得多。不过我想那种事也得挑时间地点，而早晨的公园既不占时间，也不占地点。

lines.en: scene athleticstest14
: Okay! You two know the rules, right?
lines.zh: : 好的！你们俩知道规则吧？

lines.en: : Karin, we’re arm wrestling. What kind of rules do you expect us to know?
lines.zh: : Karin，我们是在掰手腕。你指望我们知道什么规则？

lines.en: : Well...tournament rules say that-
lines.zh: : 嗯……锦标赛规则说——

lines.en: : Actually, if we’re going by tournament rules, you two wouldn’t be laying down and-
lines.zh: : 其实，要是按锦标赛规则来，你们俩就不该躺着，而且——

lines.en: : How about whoever wins, wins?
lines.zh: : 谁赢了就算谁赢，行不行？

lines.en: : Sounds good to me! I might be small, but these arms are rock hard and ready to annihilate a certain Kanda sister!
lines.zh: : 我没意见！我虽然个子小，但这双手臂硬得像石头，随时准备干掉某位 Kanda 姐妹！

lines.en: : Big words for someone who’s about to literally die.
lines.zh: : 一个马上就要真的死掉的人，口气倒是不小。

lines.en: : How would you even-
lines.zh: : 你怎么会——

lines.en: : Stay out of this, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这事你别管，Sensei。

lines.en: : Well, okay then.
lines.zh: : 那好吧。

lines.en: : Hey, you plannin’ on takin’ off those gloves? Might be a little hard to keep your grip...and I don’t want ya givin’ yourself even more of a disadvantage.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你打算把手套摘了吗？戴着手套可能不太好抓握……我可不想让你劣势更大。

lines.en: : How about you just worry about your own strategy and not mine? Kaythanks~
lines.zh: : 你管好自己的策略、别管我的行吗？谢啦~

lines.en: : Suit yourself...just tryin’ to help.
lines.zh: : 随你便……我只是想帮忙。

lines.en: : Okay...are both of you ready?
lines.zh: : 好的……你们俩都准备好了吗？

lines.en: : Heck yeah.
lines.zh: : 那还用说。

lines.en: : Bring it on...
lines.zh: : 放马过来……

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: scene athleticstest15
: {i}*Lick*{/i}
: Wha-
lines.zh: : 什么——

lines.en: scene athleticstest16
: Yay! I win!
lines.zh: : 耶！我赢了！

lines.en: : What the heck was that?!
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么玩意儿？！

lines.en: : What was what?
lines.zh: : 什么是哪个？

lines.en: : Did you friggin’ lick me?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈刚才舔了我？！

lines.en: : Yeah. Want me to do it again?
lines.zh: : 对啊。要我再舔一次吗？

lines.en: : No! Why would anyone ever want you to do somethin’ like that?!
lines.zh: : 不要！谁会想让你做那种事啊？！

lines.en: : You sure? Seemed like you liked it.
lines.zh: : 确定吗？看起来你挺喜欢的。

lines.en: : How the heck does it seem like that?! Take this seriously or-
lines.zh: : 哪里看起来像了？！你给我认真点，不然——

lines.en: : Round two goes to Kirin.
lines.zh: : 第二回合归 Kirin。

lines.en: scene athleticstest17
: Heck no it doesn’t! She cheated!
lines.zh: : 才怪！她作弊！

lines.en: : There’s no rule that says I can’t lick my opponent.
lines.zh: : 又没规定说不许舔对手。

lines.en: : Karin?
lines.zh: : Karin？

lines.en: : I mean...it’s certainly an unusual tactic, but...the rulebook online doesn’t say anything about licking.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……这确实是种不寻常的战术，不过……网上的规则手册里没提到舔的事。

lines.en: : See? Fair and square.
lines.zh: : 看到了吧？堂堂正正。

lines.en: : What does licking have to do with strength?! This competition is rigged!
lines.zh: : 舔跟力量有什么关系？！这场比赛有黑幕！

lines.en: : Looks like whoever takes the next round will be crowned the champion.
lines.zh: : 看来谁拿下下一回合，谁就是冠军了。

lines.en: : I want a do-over! I will not stand for this!
lines.zh: : 我要重来！我绝不接受这种结果！

lines.en: : Makoto! Come over here!
lines.zh: : Makoto！过来一下！

lines.en: scene black
Makoto doesn’t come over, as she’s currently in the process of discussing something with Uta.
lines.zh: Makoto 没有过来，因为她正在和 Uta 讨论什么事。

lines.en: In taking a look around, it actually seems like only around half of the class is here.
lines.zh: 环顾四周，似乎只有大约一半的同学在场。

lines.en: Ami and Noriko I already knew were gone, but Ayane and Maya seem to be absent as well.
lines.zh: Ami 和 Noriko 不在我早就知道，但 Ayane 和 Maya 似乎也没来。

lines.en: Same with Futaba and Nodoka.
lines.zh: Futaba 和 Nodoka 也是。

lines.en: Though I guess I shouldn’t expect everyone to be here for every single contest.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我也不该指望每场比赛所有人都在场。

lines.en: In fact, I didn’t even really want to be at this one.
lines.zh: 事实上，我自己都不太想来看这一场。

lines.en: At least not until Kirin started licking her classmates.
lines.zh: 至少在 Kirin 开始舔她的同学之前是不想的。

lines.en: scene athleticstest18
: Soooo, uhh...this is where you’ve been hanging out lately?
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……你最近一直都在这儿晃？

lines.en: : You mean while you’re out making drinks for people? Yup.
lines.zh: : 你是说在你出去给别人做饮料的时候？没错。

lines.en: : Not really as exciting as my old park, but it’s still kinda nice.
lines.zh: : 没有我以前那个公园有意思，不过也还挺好的。

lines.en: : Sensei comes to keep me company sometimes.
lines.zh: : Sensei 偶尔会来陪我。

lines.en: : Well, when he’s not too busy hanging out at the cafe.
lines.zh: : 当然，是在他不忙着泡咖啡店的时候。

lines.en: scene athleticstest19
: I mean...it’s not like he’s there {i}all{/i} the time, you know. Just...when he needs coffee and stuff...cause like...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……他也不是{i}一直{/i}都在那儿啊。只是……他需要咖啡什么的的时候……因为……

lines.en: : We...sell coffee and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我们……卖咖啡什么的。

lines.en: : Get out of here. Do you really?
lines.zh: : 得了吧。你们真的卖吗？

lines.en: : And...pastries...and...cute girl.
lines.zh: : 还有……糕点……还有……可爱女孩。

lines.en: : You...sell “cute girl?”
lines.zh: : 你们……卖“可爱女孩”？

lines.en: scene athleticstest20
: Ah! No! I...I wish!
lines.zh: : 啊！不是！我……我也希望能！

lines.en: : You wish?
lines.zh: : 你希望能？

lines.en: : No! I...talk with mouth again! Words bad! Bad talk!
lines.zh: : 不是！我……嘴巴又乱说了！话不会说！说得不对！

lines.en: : No sell cute girl! Sell hot bean water!
lines.zh: : 不卖可爱女孩！卖热豆汁！

lines.en: : Rin, chill. You don’t have to freak out around me. We’re cool.
lines.zh: : Rin，冷静。你不用在我面前这么慌。我们没问题的。

lines.en: scene athleticstest21
: Guh...
: But hey! On another note, our contest is up next.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来！我们的比赛就是下一场了。

lines.en: : You nervous?
lines.zh: : 你紧张吗？

lines.en: : Extremely.
lines.zh: : 紧张死了。

lines.en: : Just to make sure, are we talking about the contest or are you still just nervous because of me?
lines.zh: : 我先确认一下，你说的是比赛，还是单纯因为我在而紧张？

lines.en: scene athleticstest22
: Oh, right. Contest.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。比赛。

lines.en: : Uhh...I’m not really nervous about that, I don’t think. How about you?
lines.zh: : 呃……那个我好像不太紧张。你呢？

lines.en: : Ehhh. Maybe about him being weird or saying weird stuff or whatever. But I should be fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯……可能有点怕他很奇怪，或者说些奇怪的话什么的。不过我应该没事。

lines.en: : I’ve discovered that there’s something about him that almost everyone else sees that I just...don’t see yet or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我发现他身上有某种几乎所有人都看得到的东西，而我就是……还没看到，之类的。

lines.en: : But I guess you never know.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，谁也说不准。

lines.en: : Maybe you’ll surprise me and hold off longer than I can?
lines.zh: : 也许你会让我惊讶，比我撑得更久？

lines.en: : Emerald Guardian, is your mana low?
lines.zh: : 翡翠守卫，你的魔力见底了吗？

lines.en: : You are not talking as much as usual.
lines.zh: : 你今天话比平时少。

lines.en: scene athleticstest23
: Yeah, now that she mentions it, you’ve been unusually quiet. Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 这么一说，你确实安静得反常。是出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : I’m okay.
lines.zh: : 我没事。

lines.en: : Just tired.
lines.zh: : 只是有点累。

lines.en: : Don’t mind me.
lines.zh: : 别管我。

lines.en: : Huh...
: Well...let us know if we can do anything or whatever.
lines.zh: : 那……有什么我们能帮上忙的就说一声。

lines.en: : Yeah. I don’t know you that well or anything but-
lines.zh: : 是啊。我跟你也没那么熟，不过——

lines.en: : I’m okay.
lines.zh: : 我没事。

lines.en: : Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: scene black
It wasn’t long after the arm wrestling round that Kirin and Miku started the finale of their competition.
lines.zh: 掰手腕那一回合结束后没多久，Kirin 和 Miku 就开始了她们比赛的最终项。

lines.en: It’s rather unexciting to watch, though, as it consists of nothing more than the two of them laying there and balancing themselves on their forearms in an act of what I now know as “planking.”
lines.zh: 不过看起来相当无聊，因为无非就是她俩趴在地上，用前臂撑住身体保持平衡——我现在知道这叫“平板支撑”。

lines.en: So...I guess we just wait to see if Kirin has any tricks up her sleeve for this round as well.
lines.zh: 所以……我想我们就等着看 Kirin 这一轮是不是还藏着什么招数吧。

lines.en: scene athleticstest24
: What?! Why are ya just lookin’ at me like that?
lines.zh: : 什么？！你干嘛那样看着我？

lines.en: : Like what? Am I not allowed to look at my friend?
lines.zh: : 哪样？我还不能看我的朋友了？

lines.en: : Not after just defilin’ my body!
lines.zh: : 刚玷污了我的身体之后就不行！

lines.en: : Oh, stop. If I was going to defile you, I’d do it in private. Not in front of a bunch of people.
lines.zh: : 哦，行了。我要真想玷污你，也是私下里来，不会当着一堆人的面。

lines.en: : That whole licking thing was just strategy.
lines.zh: : 舔你那套只是战术而已。

lines.en: : Though, I will admit that you did taste a little better than I expected you to.
lines.zh: : 不过我承认，你的味道比我预想的要好一点。

lines.en: scene athleticstest25
: Why was that a thing you expected at all?! Friends don’t lick friends! That’s the kinda stuff that couples do! Probably!
lines.zh: : 你为什么会预想那个啊？！朋友之间不会互相舔的！那种事是情侣才会做的！大概吧！

lines.en: : Couples don’t really go around licking each other’s faces either, Miku.
lines.zh: : 情侣也不会到处舔对方的脸啊，Miku。

lines.en: : Though, many of them do lick each other in more exciting and interesting ways.
lines.zh: : 不过，他们确实会用更刺激有趣的方式互相舔。

lines.en: : Want to hear about that? I'll teach you.
lines.zh: : 想听听吗？我可以教你。

lines.en: scene athleticstest26
: Nope! Not listenin’ to this! I know what you’re doin’!
lines.zh: : 不要！我不听！我知道你在干什么！

lines.en: : You’re playin’ mind games with me cause ya think it’ll get me to cave! But I ain’t cavin, ya hear me?!
lines.zh: : 你在跟我玩心理战，因为你觉得这样能让我崩溃！可我不会崩溃的，你听到了吗？！

lines.en: : I won’t let any of your weird adult stuff influence me! I am Miku! Champion of justice and soccer! I will emerge victorious!
lines.zh: : 我不会让你那些奇怪的成人玩意儿影响到我！我是 Miku！正义与足球的冠军！我一定会取得胜利！

lines.en: : Hey, how much do you know about blowjobs?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你对口交了解多少？

lines.en: : Have you ever given one before?
lines.zh: : 你以前给别人口过吗？

lines.en: : La la la la la la la la! Can’t hear you!
lines.zh: : 啦啦啦啦啦啦啦啦！我听不见！

lines.en: : You know that some guys actually like it when you use your teeth?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，有些男生其实喜欢你用牙齿？

lines.en: : I didn’t believe it the first time, but then I-
lines.zh: : 我一开始也不信，但后来我——

lines.en: : Well, let’s just say I figured out it was true.
lines.zh: : 算了，总之我发现那是真的。

lines.en: : Sorry for bringing that up so randomly. Just got to thinking about it since we were talking about licking and stuff.
lines.zh: : 抱歉突然提起这个。就是聊到舔什么的，我就想到那儿去了。

lines.en: : Sensei, can you hear what they’re talking about down there?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你能听见她们俩在下面聊什么吗？

lines.en: : No. But based on Kirin’s posture and Miku’s avoidance, I think it’s safe to make assumptions.
lines.zh: : 听不见。不过看 Kirin 的姿态和 Miku 回避的样子，我觉得可以安全地做出推测。

lines.en: : You don’t think Kirin might be making fun of her or something like that, do you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会觉得 Kirin 是在拿她寻开心什么的吧？

lines.en: : I know she can be rude at times, but she really likes Miku and-
lines.zh: : 我知道她有时候挺没礼貌的，但她真的很喜欢 Miku，而且——

lines.en: : I think it’s something else, Karin.
lines.zh: : 我觉得是别的事，Karin。

lines.en: : Something else?...
lines.zh: : 别的事？……

lines.en: scene athleticstest27
: Hey...have you ever had an orgasm before?
lines.zh: : 嘿……你有过高潮吗？

lines.en: : You can tell me. I won’t say anything to anybody.
lines.zh: : 你可以告诉我。我不会跟任何人说的。

lines.en: : Die!
lines.zh: : 去死！

lines.en: : Is that any way to talk to a friend who’s trying to open up to you?
lines.zh: : 对一个想向你敞开心扉的朋友，你就这么说话？

lines.en: : Don’t you wanna hear about my first orgasm? We can compare stories and-
lines.zh: : 你不想听听我第一次高潮的事吗？我们可以交流一下经历，然后——

lines.en: : Die! Die die die die die die die die!
lines.zh: : 去死！去死去死去死去死去死去死！

lines.en: : Just thinking about it is kind of making me want to get out of here and...
lines.zh: : 光是想想就让我有点想离开这儿，然后……

lines.en: scene athleticstest28
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : That's weird...
lines.zh: : 好奇怪……

lines.en: : My legs are starting to feel all...
lines.zh: : 我的腿开始觉得……

lines.en: scene athleticstest29
: Hehehe...seems to me like your plan may have backfired, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿……看来你的计划好像适得其反了哦，Kirin。

lines.en: : What?! No! Impossible!
lines.zh: : 什么？！不！不可能！

lines.en: : This was supposed to make you fail! Not me!
lines.zh: : 本来该让你失败的！不是我！

lines.en: : Mind games are an important part of sports, so I’m proud that ya pulled out a strategy like that.
lines.zh: : 心理战是运动里很重要的一部分，所以你能使出那种策略，我还挺为你骄傲的。

lines.en: : Only thing is, sometimes, tryin’ to play mind games with people is a mind game itself.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是，有时候想对别人玩心理战，本身就是一场心理战。

lines.en: : And you, Kirin Kanda...are about to lose because of that.
lines.zh: : 而你，Kirin Kanda……就要因为这个输了。

lines.en: : No! Not like this! I refuse!
lines.zh: : 不！不该是这样的！我不接受！

lines.en: : And...for the record-
lines.zh: : 还有……顺便说一句——

lines.en: scene athleticstest30
: I {i}have{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我{i}有{/i}过。

lines.en: : Just once, though.
lines.zh: : 不过只有一次。

lines.en: : Wha-
lines.zh: : 什么——

lines.en: : {i}You?{/i}
: Goodbye, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 再见了，Kirin。

lines.en: : But...you’re Miku...and...
lines.zh: : 可是……你是 Miku 啊……而且……

lines.en: : Oh no...I...
scene black
: AAAAAAHHHHHHHH GOD FUCKING DAMNIT!
lines.zh: : AAAAAAHHHHHHHH GOD FUCKING DAMNIT!

lines.en: scene athleticstest31
: And so it appears that this contest goes to the first floor.
lines.zh: : 那么看来，这场比赛归一楼了。

lines.en: : Ha. Of course it does.
lines.zh: : 哈。那是当然。

lines.en: : This was perhaps the most one-sided competition of them all. Kirin was absolutely foolish for even thinking she could compete.
lines.zh: : 这大概是所有比赛里最一边倒的一场了。Kirin 居然以为自己能比，简直是蠢到家了。

lines.en: : Actually, Kirin wound up winning the second round. And almost the third.
lines.zh: : 其实 Kirin 拿下了第二回合。第三回合也差点赢了。

lines.en: : Apparently, Miku wound up saying some stuff that caused her to collapse during the planking part.
lines.zh: : 据说 Miku 在平板支撑环节说了些什么，导致她自己垮掉了。

lines.en: scene athleticstest32
: Miku did? That’s odd.
lines.zh: : Miku 做的？真奇怪。

lines.en: : Oh well...guess I saw this one coming.
lines.zh: : 唉算了……我早就料到会这样了。

lines.en: scene athleticstest33
: Luckily for us girls on floor two, you’re about to meet {i}our{/i} secret weapon.
lines.zh: : 不过我们二楼的女生运气好，您马上就要见到{i}我们的{/i}秘密武器了。

lines.en: : Otoha is your secret weapon? You really think she’s going to beat Rin in the friend zone fight?
lines.zh: : Otoha 是你们的秘密武器？你真觉得她能在朋友区大战里击败 Rin？

lines.en: : The what?
lines.zh: : 什么大战？

lines.en: : Excuse me, what is this next competition?
lines.zh: : 不好意思，下一场比赛到底是什么？

lines.en: : You’ll find out soon enough, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 您很快就知道了，Sensei。

lines.en: : You’ll find out soon enough...
lines.zh: : 您很快就知道了……

lines.en: scene black
Uta and Makoto turn away from me without saying anything else and I am left feeling extremely confused and mildly offended by whatever is about to happen next.
lines.zh: Uta 和 Makoto 什么都没再说就转过身去，只剩下我一头雾水，还因为接下来要发生的事感到几分被冒犯。

lines.en: Everyone remaining in the park gathers their things and starts heading to the cafe as soon as Makoto blows a whistle she was just keeping in her pocket for some reason.
lines.zh: 公园里剩下的人收拾好东西，Makoto 不知为何从口袋里掏出一个哨子一吹，大家便动身前往咖啡店。

lines.en: I imagine she just carries it everywhere because she is Makoto.
lines.zh: 我猜她就是走到哪儿都带着它，因为她是 Makoto。

lines.en: Either way, we move through the streets of Kumon-mi as a unit and eventually wind up in front of yet another familiar location.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我们一行人穿过 Kumon-mi 的街道，最终停在了又一个熟悉的地方门前。
